subject: Pacifica Healthcare — Onsite HQ visit & contactless badging logistics

Before we confirm logistics the procurement team needs a copy of the facility NDA and a short checklist for visitors (badging, parking). Can you confirm the following:
- Available windows the week of Aug 24 (morning or early afternoon)
- Onsite contacts for badging and security
- Parking/shuttle options for visitors

I attached our visitor information form for your records. Please advise next steps so we can circulate internally.

Thanks,
James O'Neill
Director of IT — Pacifica Healthcare

- Tue Aug 25: 09:30–13:00 (preferred)
- Wed Aug 26: 11:00–15:00
- Thu Aug 27: 09:00–12:30 (shorter window)

Monica (cc'd) runs HQ logistics and will confirm room/AV and badging flow.

3) Choose preferred window and approximate arrival time.

I'll also prepare a short run-of-show and contactless badging instructions for the group.

Hi all — looping in logistics details so we can lock rooms and catering. A few quick questions from ops:

1) Final headcount (including presenters) — James, you mentioned 6; confirm please.
2) AV needs: projector + HDMI, one laptop input, one conference laptop with Zoom + ability to share remote content?
3) Any special network requirements? We can provision a guest VLAN with a pre-shared key or open onboarding portal; for PHI workflows we recommend VPN/pinned environment — please advise.
4) Dietary: light boxed lunch ok? We can do gluten-free + vegetarian options.

Room options for half-day:
- Redwood Forum A (capacity 10, built-in AV, secure badge entry)
- Forum B + breakout (if you want separate breakout for clinical review)

I'll provision temporary contactless badges tied to the guest list once we have names and DOBs/ID types (for facility clearance). We can also arrange a shuttle from the nearest Caltrain station if anyone is flying in.

Attaching room assignments v2 for internal planning.

Thanks — Monica
Monica Patel
Operations Program Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

Hi Mateo / Monica —

Thanks for the options. Pacifica confirms:
- Preferred window: Mon Aug 24 is now difficult for internal reviewers; we can do Tue Aug 25 10:00–14:00 instead (arrive ~9:45 for badging) — matches your tentative hold.
- Final headcount: 6 (Dr. Nina Patel, myself, two people from Clinical Ops, one procurement rep, one IT engineer).
- AV: projector + HDMI + ability for us to connect our laptop; we'll also bring a Zoom password-protected link in case a remote director joins for 30 minutes.
- Network: we need a guest VLAN with an isolated subnet; procurement prefers that no PHI leave our devices — we'll use local demos only.

Attached: signed facility NDA (scanned). Procurement has also asked for a short statement on how Redwood handles visitor device retention policies (we can follow up with a short note).

Please confirm parking/shuttle options and the contactless badge flow. Looking forward to final calendar invite.

Thanks,
James
Director of IT — Pacifica Healthcare

Run of show (Tues Aug 25)
- 09:45 — Redwood lobby meet (I will meet you there)
- 10:00 — Intros + safety briefing (Redwood Forum A)
- 10:15 — Product demo + architecture walkthrough (with engineering team)
- 12:00 — Lunch + breakout for clinical QA

Badging / Parking / Shuttle

- Parking: we have five visitor passes held at the front desk; let me know if you need additional parking (street parking nearby is available).
- Shuttle: Palo Alto Caltrain shuttle available on request — I can reserve seats if you provide arrival times.

Monica will follow up with a short one-page note for procurement.
